note: it2 QA: identical zone predicates to the it1 QA (_it1_SUPERSEDED/qa/zones.json) for CHK-LIKE4LIKE. Zones are predicates in the datum frame (origin H1 axis x PCB top face, +X long board edge, +Z component side), written by QA from intake/INTAKE_CARD.md §3-§4 and located on the raw scan (faston row y from scan faces z 9-11). The regime (baseline-skill plastic) has no interface band (interface_max_mm null), so the named interfaces I1-I4 are reported per zone, not separately gated; the whole-part band still applies to every point in them.

zones.name: I1 board top face
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §4 I1: PCB top face (seating plane); upward-facing faces within the board outline, z -0.5..0.3

zones.name: I1 board outline edges
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §4 I1: the four board edge walls (card guides), z -1.7..0.1, near-horizontal normals

zones.name: I2 mounting holes H1 H2
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §4 I2 / E02: bore walls of H1 (0,0) and H2 (0,-51.8), r <= 2.6 about each axis (box approximation)

zones.name: I3 faston tab row
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §4 I3 / E11: six faston blades at x 36-88, y -53.7..-47.4 (located on scan faces z 9-11), z 0.3..11.5

zones.name: I4 heatsink top and tallest parts
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §4 I4: lid clearance; everything above z 12 (heatsink, clip, big caps)

zones.name: X solder side
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §3: board bottom, not scanned (reported only)

zones.name: X under heatsink clip TO-220
zones.note: INTAKE_CARD §3: x 38-55, y -41..-1, below z 12, partly occluded (reported only)
